findings.current: whether the Embroidered Uniform Guard’s chow was any good
findings.defect: The source says Jin asked whether Jeong Hogun was satisfied with his years of service in the Embroidered Uniform Guard. It does not mention food.
findings.rationale: Here, 짬밥 refers to tenure or experience from time served, not chow. The mistranslation changes the subject of Jin’s teasing.
findings.replacement: whether he was satisfied with his years of service in the Embroidered Uniform Guard

summary: One source-fidelity defect: a question about Jeong Hogun’s service in the Guard is mistranslated as a question about its food.
